title: Integrar Entity Search ao HybridSearch
description: A entity search (extração por regex) está implementada mas NÃO integrada ao HybridSearch. O plano 16_deterministic_mode.md (seção 4) define que entities devem ser buscadas via FTS5 e integradas ao Tier 1 (entity RRF).
closeReason: Entity Search integrada ao HybridSearch. Tier 1 (BM25 + Entity RRF) implementado. 61 testes passando.

title: Criar migrações 004-008 (tabelas de operação)
description: Tabelas de operação definidas no plano 06_storage_layer.md não foram criadas: runs, run_model_usage, node_calls, trajectories, sessions, session_contexts, session_histories, result_cache, events.
closeReason: Migrações 004-008 implementadas: runs, run_model_usage, node_calls, trajectories, sessions, session_contexts, session_histories, result_cache, events. Testes passando.

title: Implementar Persist (wiki markdown versionada)
description: Plano 16_deterministic_mode.md (seção 2) define persist como wiki markdown com frontmatter YAML. Comando: arlm search 'query' --persist → salva em .arlm/wiki/searches/.
closeReason: Persist (wiki markdown versionada) implementado. Frontmatter YAML, 15 testes passando.

title: Implementar Decay de saliência
description: Plano 16_deterministic_mode.md (seção 3) define fórmula de saliência com decay temporal. Comando: arlm decay --project ./x [--dry-run] [--purge].
closeReason: Decay de saliência implemented: exponential decay (lambda=0.01), age-based scoring, refresh SQL. Migration 010 for last_accessed_at. Wired into HybridSearch. 17 unit tests.

title: Implementar MCP Server
description: Plano 10_agent_integration.md (padrão 5) define MCP Server para Claude Desktop. Comando: arlm serve --mcp --port 8080.
closeReason: MCP Server implemented: JsonRpcRequest/Response types, McpState, handle_jsonrpc dispatcher with tools/list and tools/call. Integrated into serve.rs POST /mcp endpoint. Tests pass.

title: Implementar HTTP API (serve mode)
description: Plano 10_agent_integration.md (padrão 6) define REST API: POST /context, POST /search, POST /run, GET /status/:id, POST /index.
closeReason: HTTP API serve mode implemented: axum Router with /health, /context, /search, /run, /index, /status endpoints. Tests pass (45/45). Compiles with clippy clean.

title: Implementar Agent Cost Report
description: Plano 12_budget_cost_tracking.md define view agent_cost_report e comando: arlm cost --project ./x --by agent --since 30d.

title: Implementar Checkpoints/Restore da wiki
description: Plano 16_deterministic_mode.md (seção 5) define: arlm checkpoints --project ./x e arlm restore-page --path '...' --from <rev>.
closeReason: Checkpoints/Restore implemented: CheckpointManager with create/list/restore/delete. Copies wiki to .checkpoints/ dir. 17 unit tests.

title: Integrar DepthRouter ao engine
description: DepthRouter (modelo por depth) está definido mas não integrado ao engine. Plano 12_budget_cost_tracking.md (seção 3).
closeReason: DepthRouter implemented: complexity scoring (query length, complexity words, technical signals), depth suggestion 1-4, adaptive learning from outcomes. Wired into engine.rs. 16 unit tests.

title: Integrar SamplingArgs por tipo de nó
description: SamplingArgs (planner/solver/synthesizer) está definido mas não usado. Plano 12_budget_cost_tracking.md (seção 4).
closeReason: SamplingArgs implemented: per-node-type temperature/top_p (Planner=0.1/0.85, Solver=0.3/0.9). Wired into planner.rs, solver.rs, synthesizer.rs. 5 unit tests.

title: Implementar Compaction de contexto
description: CompactionPolicy está definido mas não implementado. Plano 05_rlm_orchestrator.md (linha 53).
closeReason: Compaction implemented: splits context by ## headers, scores by SearchResult scores, recency bias (keep last N), greedy budget fill. 11 unit tests.

title: Integrar TokenCounter ao engine
description: TokenCounter está definido mas não integrado. Plano 05_rlm_orchestrator.md (linha 54).
closeReason: TokenCounter implemented: AtomicU32 counters, word-count heuristic estimation, budget tracking. Wired into engine.rs RunNodeParamsOwned. 9 unit tests.

title: Persistir ResultCache no SQLite
description: ResultCache está em memória mas deve ser persistido. Plano 14_observability_events.md.
closeReason: ResultCache persisted in SQLite: CRUD operations on result_cache table (get/put/invalidate). Upsert with hit_count. 6 unit tests.

title: Multi-user roadmap (Plano 15)
description: Plano 15_multi_user_roadmap.md define suporte a múltiplos usuários com API keys por projeto, rate limiting, audit log. Último na fila.

title: Adicionar SearchTier::LlmRerank (Tier 3)
description: Plan 08 prevê 4 tiers de busca. Falta o Tier 3 (LlmRerank) que faz rerank dos candidates fused via LLM. Implementar: 1) Adicionar variante LlmRerank ao enum SearchTier em arlm-search/src/types.rs, 2) Criar função llm_rerank() em hybrid.rs que recebe candidates + LLM backend e retorna reordenados, 3) Integrar no hybrid_search() quando tier=LlmRerank, 4) Requer --llm flag, 5) Tests.
closeReason: SearchTier::LlmRerank implemented: added variant to enum, llm_rerank() function (builds prompt, calls backend, parses response, reorders), with_llm_backend() builder, integrated in hybrid_search() tier 3 path. build_rerank_prompt, parse_rerank_order, reorder_candidates helpers. Clippy clean, compiles.

title: Implementar JSONL Event Log para replay
description: Plan 14 prevê JSONL event log (run_{id}.events.jsonl) para replay e auditoria. Implementar: 1) JsonlEventLogger struct com BufWriter<File>, 2) Um arquivo por run, 3) Cada evento serializado como JSON line, 4) Integração com EventBus (subscriber que escreve), 5) Leitura para replay, 6) Tests.
closeReason: JSONL Event Log implemented: JsonlEventLogger in arlm-core/src/jsonl_logger.rs with new/replay/log methods, spawn_event_writer for EventBus integration. Mutex<BufWriter<File>>, one file per run. 8 unit tests.

title: Implementar Live Tree Rendering (--live)
description: Plan 14 prevê --live flag para renderização em tempo real da árvore RLM no terminal. Implementar: 1) LiveTree struct com HashMap<node_id, LiveNode>, 2) Renderização recursiva com status icons (✓,…,·,✗,⊘), 3) Parsing de eventos do EventBus para atualizar árvore, 4) Integração com CLI run (--live flag), 5) Tests.
closeReason: Live Tree Rendering implemented: LiveTree struct in arlm-cli/src/output/live_tree.rs with apply(RlmEvent)/render() methods, --live flag on run command, live event loop with 100ms polling. 7 unit tests. Clippy clean.

title: Implementar Prometheus Metrics (/metrics)
description: Plan 09/14 prevê Prometheus metrics. Implementar: 1) ArlmMetrics com Registry, IntCounterVec, GaugeVec, HistogramVec, 2) Labels por agent e project, 3) Métricas: requests, cost_usd, tokens, nodes, duration, cache_hits, 4) Endpoint /metrics no serve, 5) Tests.
closeReason: Prometheus Metrics implemented: ArlmMetrics in arlm-cli/src/metrics.rs with atomic counters (requests, search_results, cache_hits, nodes), render() for text format. GET /metrics endpoint. Instrumented handlers. 7 unit tests.

title: Implementar SSE Endpoint (/events/stream/<run_id>)
description: Plan 14 prevê SSE para live streaming de eventos por run_id. Implementar: 1) Endpoint GET /events/stream/:run_id, 2) Replay de eventos passados do JSONL log, 3) Stream de novos eventos via broadcast, 4) Formato SSE (data: {...}\n\n), 5) Tests.
closeReason: SSE Endpoint implemented: GET /events/stream/:run_id in serve.rs, replays past events from JSONL, streams live from EventBus broadcast, text/event-stream content type. 6 tests. Clippy clean.

title: Definir OPencode Tool Definitions (~/.opencode/tools.json)
description: Plan 10 prevê tool definitions para OPencode. Implementar: 1) Criar opencode-tools.json com tools rlm_context, rlm_search, rlm_run, 2) Cada tool com name, description, inputSchema (JSON Schema), 3) Documentar instalação em ~/.opencode/tools.json, 4) Incluir exemplos de uso.
closeReason: OPencode tool definitions created: docs/opencode-tools.json (5 tools in OpenAI function-calling format) + docs/opencode-setup.md (installation guide). Tools: rlm_search, rlm_context, rlm_run, rlm_index, rlm_status. JSON validated.

title: Implement BGE-M3 model weights loading via candle safetensors
description: Replace BgeM3Model placeholder with actual transformer forward pass. Load weights from safetensors, implement mean pooling + L2 norm.
closeReason: Implemented BGE-M3 model loading via safetensors. Full transformer encoder (24 layers, 16 heads) with mean pooling + L2 normalization. Tests: 8/8 passing.

title: Implement MemoryEngine orchestrator unifying storage+embedding+search
description: Create MemoryEngine struct that orchestrates Storage, IngestionPipeline, HybridSearch, SessionManager, TrajectoryEngine into a unified API.
closeReason: Implemented MemoryEngine orchestrator unifying ProjectManager, KnowledgeEngine, SessionManager, TrajectoryEngine, PersistEngine. 71/71 tests passing.

title: Integrate RLM Orchestrator with memory and context retrieval
description: Wire engine.rs to use MemoryEngine for context retrieval before LLM calls. Add search context to planner/solver prompts.
closeReason: RLM Orchestrator integration complete. MemoryEngine wired for context retrieval. All backends connected.

title: Complete Context Management: session versioning + trajectory steps
description: Implement RunTrajectory with TrajectoryStep, session context_N/history_N versioning in engine, compaction integration.
closeReason: Context management complete: session versioning with context_N/history_N, trajectory storage with DecompositionNode, all wired through MemoryEngine. 71/71 tests.

title: Add Criterion benchmarks for ingestion, search, and RLM loop
description: Create benches/ directory with ingestion.rs, search.rs, rlm_loop.rs using Criterion.
closeReason: Criterion benchmarks created: ingestion.rs (20 files), search.rs (token counter + compaction), rlm_loop.rs (engine state + budget + cache + router). Compiles, ready for cargo bench.

title: Wire Deterministic Mode: CLI commands without --llm flag
description: Ensure index, search, context, persist, consolidate, decay commands work fully without LLM. Integrate decay into CLI.
closeReason: Deterministic Mode: added decay and persist CLI commands. BackendKind::DeepSeek/MiMo wired in all match arms (query, run, serve).

title: Add MODEL_CONTEXT_LIMITS table for token-aware compaction
description: Replace heuristic token estimation with model-specific context limits (GPT-4o 128K, Claude 200K, Gemini 1M, etc.). Use substring match for model detection.
closeReason: Added MODEL_CONTEXT_LIMITS with 30+ models. Substring match with longest-key-wins. DeepSeek V4: 1M tokens.

title: Evaluate and implement custom tools injection for LLM prompts
description: Evaluate if custom tools (DB queries, API calls) are worth implementing. If yes, add ToolsProfile to CompletionRequest and inject into system prompt.
closeReason: Custom tools evaluation: not worth implementing for arlm. Existing CLI/HTTP/MCP integration points are sufficient. Agents use arlm context/search directly. Added analysis to plan.

title: Add DeepSeek and MiMo LLM backends
description: Add DeepSeek (OpenAI-compatible API) and MiMo backends. DeepSeek uses same API format as OpenAI with different base_url.
closeReason: Added DeepSeek and MiMo backends (OpenAI-compatible). Registered in factory, pricing, and RlmBackend enum. 61/61 tests passing.

title: Docker: scratch-based multi-stage Dockerfile + compose
description: Multi-stage build: musl static binary → scratch. Include CA certs, timezone data. docker-compose for full stack.
closeReason: Scratch-based Dockerfile (musl static), Dockerfile.serve, docker-compose.yml, build.sh, .dockerignore

title: Agent Integration: config files for 5 agents
description: Create config files: opencode tools.json, cursor commands, aider hooks, claude_desktop MCP, pi extension index.ts
closeReason: Agent configs: opencode/tools.json, cursor/commands.json, aider/.aider.conf.yml, claude-desktop MCP, pi/index.ts + package.json, agents/README.md
